rules.positive: barrow groups (60 m centroid linkage of eligible Grabhuegel, member-centroid mean in the district); core half-width max(500, ceil(half-extent) + 500) m about the group bbox centre + integer jitter U[-249, 249] (default_rng(20261004), group order; prepixel_stats.positive_cores); HR3 ownership partition over surviving groups; tile rectangles clipped to the district polygon on the 10 m grid (cells wholly inside); cluster = home square (2 km square of the member-centroid mean)
rules.nodata: per member, HR2/HR3 V1/V2: V1 >= 0.95 over pixel centres strictly inside the member polygon + 15 m, V2 >= 0.90 strictly inside the 256 m square about the member centroid; valid = finite, != NoData, pixel centre inside the district; failing members are IGNORE (30 m), empty groups drop out
rules.background: positive-square residual plus background-only squares (>= 2 km2 in frame) in random.Random(20261003).shuffle(sorted ids) order until the scored area reaches 300 km2; 1 km cells; 10 m boxes wholly inside the frame (district - 100 m), outside every realised core (all 313 groups), fully valid after a 20 m square erosion of 1 m validity, farther than 30 m from every IGNORE record (register non-members, NODATA failures, edge supplement); merged into disjoint rectangles; cluster = the 2 km square
rules.parts: group unit: union of the eligible members' register polygons; individual unit: each eligible member's polygon (region_score adds the 15 m reach)
